Thought transition effort E(ΔO) represents the cost of shifting cognition, while spontaneous internal activity A(T) reflects self-generated motion within thought. Muscular sense duality links these to physical correlates via muscle tension M(D), enabling empirical validation. These operators form a closed-loop system where effort drives activity, and activity influences perception of effort. The failure mode occurs when E(ΔO) is misestimated, leading to incorrect belief updates in GSI or incorrect state transitions in GSE.
